zra setup — hook ZRA into Zed

  status               installation status (default)

  --name <id>          entry name in Zed, for a single agent

  --yes                do not ask for confirmation before renaming or removing
                       existing ZRA entries (a bare "yes" works too)
  --record             debugging: records every ACP frame in
                       .zra/records/ (ZRA_RECORD), conversations included

  e.g. npm run setup install apply
      npm run setup install qwen-code pi-acp apply
